description: Header file defining the implementation of a CMDU server class (CmduServerImpl) for sending and receiving CMDU messages over socket connections, including connection management, event handling, and message forwarding.

classes.name: CmduServerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a CMDU server handling socket connections, message transmission, and event management.

methods.name: CmduServerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing server socket, parser, serializer, and event loop.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message through a socket.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to a specified destination.

methods.name: set_client_name
methods.description: Sets the client name for a connection.

methods.name: add_connection
methods.description: Adds a new socket connection and registers event handlers.

methods.name: remove_connection
methods.description: Removes a socket connection and its event handlers.

methods.name: handle_connect
methods.description: Handles incoming connection requests on the server socket.

methods.name: handle_read
methods.description: Handles data reception and CMDU parsing on a client socket.

methods.name: handle_close
methods.description: Handles disconnection and cleanup of a client socket.
